title: What Lifts My Mood — Activity Correlation
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mood:entry
| eval activity=mvindex(split(tags,","),0)
| stats avg(mood_score) as avg_mood, count as days by activity
| where days>=5
| sort - avg_mood
description: Compares your average mood across the activities you tag, revealing which things reliably lift you up.
value: Learning that, say, exercise or seeing friends consistently raises your mood turns vague advice into personal evidence.
implementation: Ingest mood entries with activity tags; review average mood by tagged activity.
visualization: Bar chart of average mood by tagged activity.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which activities tend to lift your mood most, based on your own diary entries.
